external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
external_entities.notes: The text does not specify whether colleagues are employees, contractors, or another category.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us

external_entities.name: franchise store
external_entities.description: A franchise store whose colleagues are allowed to use the system.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group-membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated by the franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates the franchise identity-provider sign-in, retrieves HR changes, and writes audit events.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The broker's second-factor behavior is undocumented.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text also does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: A franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague as part of sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: franchise sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker accepts the franchise identity provider's vouching as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not state the protocol or the permitted population of franchise colleagues.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a signed token to the store admin console for a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and group list.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group memberships

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the store admin console to change prices or void transactions when authorized by the token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: store signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps its signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group membership information in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The same overnight pull is described as how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not say what the log records.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home from which they may sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-store environment whose colleagues are allowed to use the system.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The corporate network is a network trust zone because the identity broker and store admin console are explicitly described as running there.
assumptions.basis: The source says, 'The broker runs on the corporate network' and that the store admin console 'also runs on the corporate network.'

assumptions.assumption: Home devices are a tenant trust zone because they are colleagues' own devices outside the organisation's control.
assumptions.basis: The source says colleagues use 'their own devices at home.'

assumptions.assumption: Franchise stores are a tenant trust zone because they are a separate franchise environment outside the organisation's control.
assumptions.basis: The source says, 'We also let the franchise stores in' and separately describes franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
